verdict.rationale: Airweave is an API platform used by agents, so scoped or least-privilege credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped, restricted, or per-agent API keys. Direct token injection and auth providers cover supplying credentials for third-party sources, which is an adjacent feature and not agent credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
